SELECT member_id AS memberId, name, email, phone, nickname, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURRENT_DATE()) AS age, gender, profile_img_url AS profileImageUrl, (identity_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AS identityVerified, (region_verified_at IS NOT NULL) AS regionVerified FROM members WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
